source: Lets start with a simple baseplate where the player is a physics based vehicle, for now no model but I want to have the player to be spawned into a floating part resembling the sizes of a scooter
scene_prompt: Create a simple 3D baseplate map with open, unobstructed ground. At the player spawn area, place a small floating rectangular part sized to resemble a scooter footprint, with no vehicle model or additional structures.
blob:
### Genre
This is Simulation: the author specifies a physics-based vehicle, so the space is a vehicle test context rather than a purely decorative baseplate.

### Shape and preset
Use `world-shared`, matching the Vehicle Sim preset in its simplest form. The prompt overrides the preset’s roads and resource field: this is only an open test baseplate.

### Config requirements
No image configuration options apply. Do not add roads, scenery, resource areas, buildings, or vehicle meshes that were not requested.

### Layout requirements
No placed gameplay volumes are needed beyond one implicit player arrival location at the floating part; no canonical layout option is required for this minimal test scene.

### Layout components
Build one broad, flat, open baseplate of unobstructed ground, with no terrain relief, boundaries, paths, props, or structures. Place a single small rectangular part at the player spawn area, floating just above the baseplate and proportioned to a scooter footprint. It is a bare placeholder platform, not a modeled scooter. Keep the rest of the surface empty and clearly navigable. Frame the baseplate and floating spawn part together in a simple isometric view.

### Render order
Use `isometric`: no topology needs validation, and the simple visual test scene can lead.

### Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
Scale is small, driven by one empty baseplate and one spawn placeholder. Theme is minimal neutral physics-test sandbox. Use `P0`; the single flat surface forces no additional pipeline pass.

td_prompt: Convert the referenced scene into a TRUE overhead nadir minimap layout. Camera is straight down (90° top-down), ZERO perspective and ZERO isometric tilt. Show ONLY the tops of objects. NO building walls, NO doorways, NO awnings, NO side faces, NO vertical surfaces of any kind. Flat game-minimap / floor-plan style with clean flat color zones. Preserve the EXACT position, shape, size and orientation of every object from the reference image. Tightly crop to the occupied layout footprint; everything outside the footprint must be pure black (#000000). Square output.
